result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled orders, so your January example comes out as Anna 2, Bob 1.

- **Fix** in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`: added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same condition the per-quarter and per-weekday purchase-order counts use.
- **Test** in `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`: new `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders` case that reproduces your example. I also added a status-taking overload of the `purchaseOrder` test helper to support it.
- **Verified:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes, 4 of 4 tests.

Nothing is committed.
